02 / THE STUDIO

More than a tattoo.
A piece of who you are.

A small detail. A turning point. Something you’ve always felt, finally made visible. The best pieces start with a conversation.

This is a concept for a studio built around thoughtful design and individual expression. A place for your ideas to take shape, in your own time.

05 / FROM IDEA TO INK

Good art starts
with a conversation.

  1. 01

    Bring the idea.

    A thought, a reference, a feeling. Share your style, placement and what the piece means to you.

  2. 02

    Make it personal.

    Discuss the design with the artist. Refine the details, agree the quote and confirm your session.

  3. 03

    Carry it forward.

    Your session, followed by the studio’s personal aftercare guidance and a chance to follow up.

A LITTLE CARE GOES A LONG WAY

The story
continues.

Your artist’s own preparation and aftercare guidance will be shared before and after your appointment.

BEFORE YOUR VISIT

Bring your references, inspiration and questions to the consultation.

AFTER YOUR SESSION

STAY IN TOUCH

Know how to contact the studio with questions after your appointment.

The studio will add its approved aftercare instructions before launch.
